three.js r185 / npm 0.185.0 (MIT)
  Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r185
  Archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.185.0.tgz
  SHA-256: 5f52a93ffb7d5bd87735d414fad83709af45ddcb77f8c1198dda98971074433d
  Files: build/three.module.min.js, build/three.core.min.js,
         examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js,
         examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js,
         examples/jsm/utils/SkeletonUtils.js, LICENSE (LICENSE.three).
  Modification: GLTFLoader.js imports ./BufferGeometryUtils.js and
         ./SkeletonUtils.js instead of ../utils/ paths to fit this directory.
  All "three" imports resolve through the viewer's local import map.

Reproduction: python3 ../tools/download_assets.py from this directory,
or python3 html/viewer/mavlink/tools/download_assets.py from the repo root.
Requires Python 3.9+ and curl; library archive hashes are verified.
